payload.instruction: Stuffing the paper into the cup
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

outcome.description: Paper is stuffed into the cup.
outcome.target: The paper is visibly placed inside the cup, with evidence that it has been stuffed into it rather than merely resting nearby or on its rim.
outcome.reference: The requested edit is stated in the instruction: “Stuffing the paper into the cup”.

check.question: Does the image show the paper stuffed inside the cup?
check.complete_when: The paper is visibly inside the cup and appears stuffed into it.
check.partial_when: There is visible progress toward putting the paper into the cup, but it is not fully stuffed inside (for example, it is partly inserted or draped over the rim).
check.absent_when: The paper is confidently visible outside the cup with no visible progress toward putting it inside.
check.unknown_when: The paper or cup is not sufficiently visible to determine whether the requested edit was made.

response.content: {"status":"absent","evidence":"The edited image shows a hand holding a flat paper item outside the cup; no paper is visibly inserted into or draped over the cup. The requested change has not visibly progressed."}
